list.definition:
SELECT group_id::VARCHAR AS group_id
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, 1

panels.title: Selected groups (latest day in range)
panels.description: Number of instruments and distinct groups among the selected `$group` values on the latest trading day in the time range. Source: the `b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse` parquet (B3 AgrupamentoInstrumentosPadronizados.txt, one row per instrument per group per day). The latest day is the most recent `trad_dt` that has data for the selected groups.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE group_id::VARCHAR IN ($group)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments,
  count(DISTINCT group_id)::BIGINT AS group_count
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Instruments per group per day
panels.description: Daily count of instruments (rows) in each selected standardized instrument group, from the `b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse` parquet. One line per `group_id`; filtered by the `$group` variable and the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, group_id::VARCHAR AS group_id, count(*)::BIGINT AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE group_id::VARCHAR IN ($group)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, group_id

panels.title: Largest groups (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 20 groups by instrument count on the latest trading day in the time range, with their count on the first day of the range and the change between them. Source: `b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse` parquet, counted per `group_id` per `trad_dt`. Not filtered by `$group`; only the time range applies.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM d
),
s AS (
  SELECT group_id,
    coalesce(max(instruments) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = last_day), 0) AS instruments,
    coalesce(max(instruments) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = first_day), 0) AS instruments_at_start
  FROM d CROSS JOIN b
  GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT group_id::VARCHAR AS group_id,
  instruments::BIGINT AS instruments,
  instruments_at_start::BIGINT AS instruments_at_start,
  (instruments - instruments_at_start)::BIGINT AS change
FROM s
ORDER BY instruments DESC, group_id
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Biggest group size changes (first vs latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 20 groups ranked by the absolute change in instrument count between the first and latest trading day in the time range, with the percentage change. Source: `b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse` parquet, counted per `group_id` per `trad_dt`; groups with no change are hidden. Not filtered by `$group`; the percentage is empty for groups that did not exist on the first day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM d
),
s AS (
  SELECT group_id,
    coalesce(max(instruments) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = last_day), 0) AS instruments,
    coalesce(max(instruments) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = first_day), 0) AS instruments_at_start
  FROM d CROSS JOIN b
  GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT group_id::VARCHAR AS group_id,
  instruments_at_start::BIGINT AS instruments_at_start,
  instruments::BIGINT AS instruments,
  (instruments - instruments_at_start)::BIGINT AS change,
  ((instruments - instruments_at_start) / nullif(instruments_at_start, 0))::DOUBLE AS change_pct
FROM s
WHERE instruments <> instruments_at_start
ORDER BY abs(instruments - instruments_at_start) DESC, group_id
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Instruments added/removed in selected groups (within range)
panels.description: Instruments that joined (first seen after the first day of the range) or left (last seen before the latest day) the selected `$group` groups within the time range, with first/last seen dates and the number of sessions present. Source: `b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse` parquet, keyed by `instrument_id` and `group_id`. An instrument that both joined and left within the range is shown as removed; output is capped at 2000 rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE group_id::VARCHAR IN ($group)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM d
),
s AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, group_id,
    min(trad_dt) AS first_seen,
    max(trad_dt) AS last_seen,
    count(*) AS sessions,
    any_value(first_day) AS first_day,
    any_value(last_day) AS last_day
  FROM d CROSS JOIN b
  GROUP BY instrument_id, group_id
)
SELECT instrument_id::VARCHAR AS instrument_id,
  group_id::VARCHAR AS group_id,
  CASE WHEN last_seen < last_day THEN 'removed' ELSE 'added' END AS status,
  strftime(first_seen, '%Y-%m-%d') AS first_seen,
  strftime(last_seen, '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_seen,
  sessions::BIGINT AS sessions
FROM s
WHERE first_seen > first_day OR last_seen < last_day
ORDER BY CASE WHEN last_seen < last_day THEN last_seen ELSE first_seen END DESC, group_id, instrument_id
LIMIT 2000
